== Biography ==
James was born before 1670. He was the son of [[Caldwell-359|John Caldwell]] and [[Arid-2|Jennet Arid]]. He passed away in 1753.

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns James Coldwell. The banns/marriage index records Isob Glasgow and James Coldwell/ on 17 April 1684 at Glasgow.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 644 / 1/230 / 285; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. Isob Glasgow and James Coldwell have no proven compatible local/live identity. The identification remains uncertain.
